$comment: One entry per provider. versions lists every version this site serves, latest last -- the committed list, not a live release-list query per repo per build (UBI-240: a build that queries live lists produces different output depending on when it runs). Adding a version is a one-line change, visible in review; scripts/check_sdk_pins.py fails the build when a release exists that is not listed here, so the one-line change is prompted rather than remembered. repo is the real GitHub repo the docs release lives on; each version's own release tag is a bare vX.Y.Z on that repo, distinct from its sdk/go/vX.Y.Z module tag. There is deliberately no goModule field: a Go module path carries its major version from v2 onward, so it is a function of the version being documented and is derived per version in scripts/build-examples.mjs. One field per provider could not describe aws once it served both 2.x and 3.0.0 pages.

kubernetes.outputCaveat: Kubernetes's own OpenAPI spec marks read-only fields in prose, inside each field's own description text, rather than with a structural readOnly keyword. This reference has no way to detect that from the spec alone, so resources here never show a separate Output properties section, even where real server-set fields exist (for example ObjectMeta's own uid, resourceVersion, and creationTimestamp). This is a limitation of the upstream spec, not missing or broken data.
